title: Active Learning under Simulated Class Imbalance and Label Shift in Binary Semantic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2601.06209v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The aim of Active Learning is to select the most informative samples from an unlabelled set of data. This is useful in cases where the amount of data is large and labelling is expensive, such as in machine vision or medical imaging. Two particularities of machine vision are first, that most of the images produced are free of defects, and second, that the amount of images produced is so big that we cannot store all acquired images. This results, on the one hand, in a strong class imbalance in defect distribution and, on the other hand, in a potential label shift caused by limited storage. To understand how these two forms of imbalance affect active learning algorithms, we propose a simulation study based on two open-source datasets. Our contribution is not a new acquisition strategy but a controlled and reproducible protocol that synthetically constructs datasets in which the levels of class imbalance and label shift are fixed a

translated_title: 二元语义分割中模拟类别不平衡与标签偏移下的主动学习
translated_abstract: 主动学习的目标是从未标注的数据集中挑选出信息量最大的样本。这在数据量大且标注成本高昂的场景中非常有用，例如机器视觉或医学成像领域。机器视觉有两个特点：其一，产生的图像大多没有缺陷；其二，产生的图像数量极其庞大，以至于我们无法存储所有采集到的图像。这一方面导致缺陷分布上存在强烈的类别不平衡，另一方面，有限的存储空间又可能引发标签偏移。为了理解这两种不平衡形式如何影响主动学习算法，我们基于两个开源数据集提出了一项模拟研究。我们的贡献并非提出一种新的采集策略，而是提供一个可控且可复现的协议，通过合成方式构建类别不平衡程度和标签偏移程度均被固定设定的数据集……
tldr: 该论文的贡献不是新的主动学习采集策略，而是提出了一个基于两个开源数据集的可控、可复现的模拟协议，用于系统研究类别不平衡与标签偏移这两种不平衡形式对二元语义分割中主动学习算法的影响。
en_tdlr: Rather than proposing a new acquisition strategy, this paper presents a controlled and reproducible simulation protocol based on two open-source datasets to systematically study how class imbalance and label shift affect active learning in binary semantic segmentation.
